operators.name: Enedis
operators.coverage: About 95 % of the distribution of mainland France; the rest is served by local distribution companies.
operators.description: The main distribution operator: connection, Linky meters, meter data (Data Connect), the operator side of collective self-consumption.

operators.name: RTE
operators.coverage: The transmission grid of mainland France.
operators.description: The transmission system operator: the high-voltage grid, balancing, the connection of large plants, the public data of the system.

operators.name: EDF Systèmes Énergétiques Insulaires
operators.coverage: Corsica and the overseas departments but Mayotte, not interconnected with the mainland.
operators.description: Distribution and system operation of the non-interconnected zones (zones non interconnectées).

operators.name: Strasbourg Électricité Réseaux
operators.coverage: Strasbourg and about 400 municipalities of the Bas-Rhin.
operators.description: The largest local distribution company (entreprise locale de distribution).

operators.name: GreenAlp
operators.description: The distribution subsidiary of Gaz Électricité de Grenoble.

operators.name: SRD
operators.coverage: Most of the Vienne department outside Poitiers.
operators.description: Local distribution company of the Vienne.

operators.name: Gérédis
operators.description: Local distribution company of the Deux-Sèvres.

operators.name: Électricité de Mayotte
operators.description: Producer, distribution operator and supplier of Mayotte.

voltage_levels.reference: Article R. 4226-2, alternating current: TBT up to 50 V, BT up to 1 000 V, HTA up to 50 kV, HTB above; the upper bound of HTB is the highest voltage of the transmission grid, 400 kV
